title: Stored journey
description: One journey as a read returns it, with its aliases and the services that touched it.

id.description: Decrypted for display. Null when the key that encrypted it is no longer held.

label.description: The journeyLabel of the event last in timeline order, (timestamp, received at, event id), that carried one. Null until an event carries one.

lastStep.description: The name of the event last in timeline order, (timestamp, received at, event id), failing or not. Null for a journey no event has reached since the server was upgraded to store it.

failedStep.description: The name of the failing event latest in timeline order, (timestamp, received at, event id), among the failures applied since the journey last became failed. Null whenever status is not failed, and for a failed journey whose failure predates the server storing it, where a reader falls back to lastStep.

displayValue.description: Masked, because an alias may be an identifier the caller is not entitled to see in full, unless displayable is true. Null when the key that encrypted it is no longer held.

displayable.description: True when every event that stated this alias listed it in displayableAliases; displayValue is then the whole value.
